name: installer-tool
description: A web-based tool for creating Windows installers using NSIS (Nullsoft Scriptable Install System). This tool provides a simple web interface where users can upload files and provide NSIS scripts to generate executable installers.

scripts.postinstall: echo "✅ NSIS Installer Tool ready! Make sure you have NSIS installed." && echo "📖 For Windows: Download from https://nsis.sourceforge.io/Download" && echo "📖 For Linux: sudo apt-get install nsis" && echo "📖 For macOS: brew install nsis"
scripts.setup-nsis: echo "🔧 Setting up NSIS environment..." && echo "📁 NSIS plugins are bundled with this project in ./nsis-plugins/" && echo "✅ No additional setup required - just install NSIS and run npm start!"
